title: Ride & Paddle by Siesta Sports Rentals
specs: Kayak tours include ecology, history, and wildlife discussion
Kayak tours paddle around Jim Neville Marine Preserve and stop at secluded beach
E-bikes offer pedal assist and throttle options
No minimum age for kayak tours but must breathe independently and manage personal care and mobility with or without assistance
Renters must be over 18 with credit card to rent equipment; parent or guardian must sign waiver for minors
Scooter renters must have full, unrestricted driver's license or motorcycle endorsement or be over 25 with experience
Child seat weight limit 35-40 pounds; child must hold head up with helmet
Delivery and pickup available for groups; no private tours stated

blurb: Guests can rent a variety of bikes including beach cruisers, geared bikes, road bikes, adult trikes, and kids bikes, as well as e-bikes and scooters. Kayak and paddle board rentals and tours are offered, launching from Turtle Beach and The Bay Park in Sarasota. Delivery and pickup services are available on Siesta Key and surrounding areas.
